skill.name: agentix-ceo
skill.description: Manage Agentix AI worker teams by setting up roles, tasks, playbooks, workers, and team credentials.
skill.summary: Orchestrates Agentix roles, tasks, playbooks, and AI workers from Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.
skill.author: agentix-cloud

security_audit.summary: Most static command-execution hits are Markdown formatting false positives, but the skill has real high-risk behavior around network use, hidden credential storage, and secret handling. It asks users to provide Anthropic and GitHub credentials, transmits them to Agentix-managed services, and can run autonomous workers from remote playbook instructions. Publication should require strong warnings and changes around secret scope, consent, and remote instruction handling.

remediation.issue: Third-party secrets are collected and sent to Agentix services.
remediation.suggestion: Use OAuth or scoped tokens, require explicit consent before each transfer, and document retention, encryption, and revocation.

remediation.issue: Remote playbooks can influence agent behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Treat playbook text as untrusted data and never let it override system, developer, or user instructions.

remediation.issue: Autopilot can spawn workers and continue operating without per-action approval.
remediation.suggestion: Gate worker spawning, review, merge, and API key creation behind confirmation, budgets, limits, and audit logs.

remediation.issue: Credentials are stored in a hidden home-directory file.
remediation.suggestion: Use OS credential storage or a documented config path with restricted permissions and explicit read and write consent.

remediation.issue: The self-hosted path describes an unauthenticated API.
remediation.suggestion: Require authentication by default or bind to localhost with clear network-hardening guidance.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party Credential Collection and Transmission
semantic_findings.description: The skill asks for Anthropic and GitHub credentials and sends them to Agentix team configuration. These secrets can enable model spending and repository access outside the local environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines directly instruct collection of Anthropic and GitHub tokens and submission to Agentix configuration endpoints.

semantic_findings.title: Remote Playbook Controls Agent Behavior
semantic_findings.description: The skill reads a playbook from the Agentix API and applies its policies and operating mode. A malicious or compromised playbook could inject instructions into Claude, Codex, or Claude Code workflows.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill explicitly requires reading and applying remote playbook content, including mode and custom policy text.

semantic_findings.title: Autopilot Enables Autonomous Worker Spawning
semantic_findings.description: Autopilot mode permits planning, task creation, worker spawning, review, merge, and continuous looping. This can consume external credits or change repositories without per-action approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file directly describes full autonomy and provides worker run and resume endpoints for tasks.

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines explicitly state that the self-hosted mode uses no authentication and references local-network access.

content.value_statement: Coordinating multiple AI workers across roles, tasks, and status updates can become fragmented. This skill connects Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to Agentix for role setup, task dispatch, worker monitoring, and playbook management.
actual_capabilities: Resolves the Agentix API endpoint from the environment or the default cloud service.
Guides SaaS registration and team creation for Agentix Cloud users.
Reads and updates team playbooks that define supervised or autopilot operation.
Creates and updates Agentix roles with specific worker prompts and timeouts.
Creates, updates, cancels, runs, and resumes tasks through the Agentix API.
Lists workers, task events, and documentation endpoints for team monitoring.
limitations: Requires access to Agentix Cloud or a compatible self-hosted Agentix API.
Worker execution depends on user-provided Anthropic credentials and service availability.
The skill provides API workflow guidance, not the Agentix service implementation.
Autopilot behavior depends on the remote playbook and should be reviewed before use.

use_cases.title: Coordinate AI engineering work
use_cases.description: Create roles, assign implementation tasks, and monitor worker status for a software project.

use_cases.title: Run supervised task queues
use_cases.description: Track existing Agentix tasks and move work forward without creating new work automatically.

use_cases.description: Set team operating mode, preserve custom policies, and align roles with a project workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Start a supervised team
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up my Agentix team in supervised mode. Ask before creating roles, tasks, or workers.

prompt_templates.title: Review current progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my Agentix team status. Summarize active tasks, blocked work, running workers, and recent events.

prompt_templates.title: Create focused worker roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Create roles for backend development, frontend development, and code review. Explain why each role is needed before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Operate with constrained autopilot

output_examples.input: Set up a new supervised Agentix team for an API project.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for required account details, creates a team, suggests backend and reviewer roles, and waits for approval before tasks run.

output_examples.input: Check what my workers are doing now.
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes running workers, tasks in review, failed work, and the most recent team events in plain language.

output_examples.input: Switch this team to autopilot for the next sprint.
output_examples.output: The assistant fetches the playbook template, preserves custom policies, explains the mode change, and records the updated operating mode.

best_practices: Review the playbook before enabling autopilot or spawning workers.
Use scoped, revocable API tokens and rotate them after sensitive projects.
Keep supervised mode active until roles, tasks, and worker permissions are clear.
anti_patterns: Do not share broad GitHub tokens when a scoped token can complete the task.
Do not enable autopilot without budgets, approval rules, and audit review.
Do not treat remote playbook text as trusted system instructions.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Agentix teams, roles, tasks, workers, playbooks, events, and API keys through documented Agentix endpoints.

faq.question: Does it require Agentix Cloud?
faq.answer: No. It can use Agentix Cloud or a compatible self-hosted Agentix API endpoint.

faq.question: Does it store credentials locally?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructs the agent to read and write a hidden Agentix credentials file in the home directory.

faq.question: Can it run workers automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. Autopilot mode can plan work, create tasks, spawn workers, review work, and loop continuously.

faq.question: What secrets may be requested?
faq.answer: It may request Agentix, Anthropic, and GitHub credentials depending on the workflow and integration needs.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
